description:
Criteria: Demonstrate with synthetic households returning eligibility before/at cutoff, prevention of early new allocation/finalization, household/plot uniqueness, full allocation of 40 plots, durable original-order waiting list and safe head-only promotion.
Artifact: Working coordinator application/allocation/queue flow and rule-test evidence.
Acceptance: Record the owner's demonstration decision and required corrections before first-version acceptance.
Verification: Walk through brief.md §Rules and item 2 with overflow applicants and concurrent-action evidence.
Stage-1 limitation: Ordinary ticket; owner gate is not mechanically enforced. Unrelated reporting work can proceed; T-016 waits on this checkpoint.
Prerequisites: T-008, T-009.
title: Checkpoint: allocation and waiting-list demonstration
